item: An installer or prepare failure after a followed redirect says only a status or a class (R142), and no host list reaches further than its consent-popup lane (R143)
key_paths: src/llm/installer.py; src/safety/fetcher.py; src/wiki/client.py; src/wiki/ores.py; src/services/duckduckgo.py; src/api/llm.py; tests/test_session_host_list.py; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md; docs/ledger/RULINGS_INDEX.md
summary: R142: the installer's release lookup and its download answered an HTTP error, a dropped connection, a timeout, an unreadable Location or a body that is not JSON with the exception's own text, which for a followed redirect quotes the signed storage address (query included) into the 500 and the log. Both fetches now raise InstallerFetchFailed (a verification error, so /api/llm/install/prepare answers 502 through http_detail): a fixed sentence per stage plus only HTTP <status> or the exception's class name (src.safety.fetcher.failure_words), raised after the except block so there is no cause and no context, and logged with the same two words and no exc_info. TransportUnavailable and NetworkBlocked pass through unchanged and a host-list refusal stays InstallerRedirectRefused. One planted-signature sink test per stage and per kind of failure, each failing only when its own scrub goes (12 mutants killed). R143: a code list is never wider than the consent popup's lane, pinned by one test over all 11 lists. WIKI_SESSION_HOSTS is exactly .wikipedia.org, wikimedia.org and stream.wikimedia.org (no .wikimedia.org suffix), ORES_HOSTS is ores.wikimedia.org and the DuckDuckGo ALLOWED_HOSTS is html.duckduckgo.com, each with an exact-list test that only it fails (13 mutants killed). A redirect inside the domain but off the exact host now fails closed with the existing named refusal; whether the real services ever answer that way is an operator look recorded STILL OPEN in OPEN_QUEUE.md (for ORES it is Q717's look too), not an observation. Rows R142 and R143 added to RULINGS_INDEX.
